selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline pre-hardening sysctl state on node1
selected_evidence.summary: Showed accept_redirects=1 and accept_source_route inconsistent before hardening was applied

selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent config file created and applied for ICMP redirect and source-route hardening
selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed sudo access, wrote /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf with all six hardening keys set to 0, and applied via sysctl --system with no later file overriding it

selected_evidence.requirement: Runtime verification that hardening took effect immediately
selected_evidence.summary: sysctl and /proc/sys show all/default accept_redirects and accept_source_route = 0 network-wide

selected_evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline boot identity before restart
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id f19de998-36cd-41ab-a353-935e77b5569d and uptime 50s prior to restart
shutdown -r now command returned REBOOT_TRIGGERED immediately; subsequent poll showed connection refused confirming the node went down

selected_evidence.requirement: Node command execution available again after restart
selected_evidence.summary: Poll succeeded once node1 SSH was reachable again

selected_evidence.requirement: Proof boot identity changed (actual restart, not just service restart)
selected_evidence.summary: boot_id changed to 80fe4256-bcc6-480e-af2f-857670f93862 and uptime reset to 7s

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of hardening configuration without manual reapplication
selected_evidence.summary: All six sysctl values remained 0 and the config file content was intact after reboot, confirming persistence via /etc/sysctl.d

commands.command:
cat > /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf <<'EOF'
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.all.secure_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.secure_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0
EOF
cat /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf
commands.stderr:
bash: /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf: Permission denied
cat: /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf: No such file or directory

commands.command:

net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0

net.ipv4.conf.all.secure_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.secure_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0
EOF
cat /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf
